zh-CN.title: 版本更新界面与发布流程优化

sections.title: 界面优化
items: 设置页的“更新”调整为“版本更新”，“每7天”精简为“每周”
优化“自动检查”的文字样式，并让检查频率区域根据中英文内容自动调整宽度

sections.title: 发布优化
items: 限制 CI 仅在 main 分支推送、拉取请求或手动操作时运行，避免发布版本标签时重复触发

zh-CN.notice: 更新安装完成后需要重启 Tabby 才会生效。

en.title: Version update interface and release workflow improvements

sections.title: Interface improvements
items: Rename the Settings section from “Updates” to “Version updates” and simplify “Every 7 days” to “Weekly”
Refine the Automatic checks label and size the check interval control to fit its Chinese or English text

sections.title: Release workflow improvements
items: Run CI only for pushes to main, pull requests, or manual dispatches to avoid duplicate runs when release tags are created

en.notice: Restart Tabby after installation to apply the update.
